items.name: Pastime Coffee
items.what: Founded in 2024, this young Portland roaster just opened its own production roastery in Northeast Portland, built around a 15-kilo Sivetz roaster. Its Sure Thing blend is a light-medium roast with caramel, citrus and nut notes.

sources.name: Daily Coffee News: Pastime Coffee goes all in at new Portland production roastery

items.name: Pelican Lite IPA
items.what: Pelican's first low-calorie, low-carb beer is a 5.4% ABV IPA with 122 calories and 3 grams of carbs per 12 ounces, brewed in Tillamook with citrus and pine hop notes and a dry finish. Light versions of other Pelican favorites are planned for 2027.

where_to_buy.store: Pelican Brewing locations and select retailers in Oregon, Washington, Idaho and Northern California

items.name: Peach Sour and Fresh Hop Hazy IPA
items.what: For its 10th anniversary, the Cannon Beach brewery rolled out new can labels designed in Portland plus two limited beers: a 6.5% Peach Sour with Willamette Valley peaches and a 7.1% Fresh Hop Hazy IPA made with Magnum and Cascade hops from its own Public Coast Farm.

where_to_buy.store: Public Coast Brewing Co., Cannon Beach

items.name: Breakside IPA and Brewery of the Year
items.what: Milwaukie's Breakside was named Brewery of the Year in its size category at the 2026 Great American Beer Festival, leaving with six medals including three golds. Its flagship Breakside IPA won gold in American IPA against 164 other entries, and Summer Classic and Hello My Alien also took golds.

items.name: Golden Lime Cosmic Crisp cider
items.what: A not-yet-officially-launched cider of Cosmic Crisp apples and calamansi golden limes won silver in Fruited Cider at GABF 2026, the festival's biggest cider category with 58 entries; 2 Towns' Huckleberry Cosmic Crisp took bronze for the second year running. For now it's only in a 2 Towns variety pack.

items.what: The young Bend brewery was one of two Oregon breweries named Brewery of the Year at the 2026 Great American Beer Festival, winning the 251 to 500 barrel category.

items.name: Cheers to the Land 2026
items.maker: Oregon Agricultural Trust with 16 Oregon breweries and cideries
items.what: This year's run of farmland-benefit beers and ciders from Breakside, Baerlic, Bauman's, Gigantic, Hopworks, Deschutes and others launched with a beer fest at John's Marketplace on October 10. Proceeds support the trust's work to permanently protect Oregon farmland.

items.name: 2022 Demi-Sec Rosé and fall sparkling releases
items.what: The Willamette Valley sparkling house marked its 10th harvest with four fall releases, including its first-ever sweet wine, a 2022 Demi-Sec Rosé ($70, just 40 cases) blended from six Willamette Valley sites, and a 2020 Cuvée One aged five years en tirage ($95).

items.maker: Steven Smith Teamaker and Ranger Chocolate Co.
items.what: Two Portland makers teamed up on a six-piece bonbon set inspired by Smith teas Lord Bergamot, Golden Light and Masala Chai, previewed at a launch party during the Portland Craft Chocolate Festival. Retail availability wasn't announced.

items.name: Fresh Coast Hospitality fresh hop IPA
items.what: Took gold in Fresh Hop Pale Ales and IPAs, the biggest category at the Oregon Beer Awards fresh hop competition on October 3, with Sunriver's Fresh Whammies taking silver. The competition drew 134 entries from 44 Oregon breweries, so look for these while fresh hop season lasts.

items.name: Rogue River Blue, 2026 vintage
items.what: Rogue Creamery's once-a-year blue, aged 9 to 11 months and wrapped in Syrah grape leaves soaked in pear spirits, debuts its new vintage each fall on the autumnal equinox. It was the first US cheese to win the World Cheese Awards.

items.name: Glacier Gourmet freeze-dried treats
items.what: A Redmond couple's freeze-dried snack line, launched in 2024, is now in more than 100 Oregon stores. Best sellers are freeze-dried Oregon dark cherry and marionberry pie ice creams, plus fruits, candies and cheesecakes.

items.what: The Corvallis cidery's fall pumpkin cider is back for 2026 in its classic form, with golden delicious pumpkin and a custom blend of pumpkin pie spices, at 6.9% ABV.

items.name: Gluten Free 1-to-1 Baking Flour, new formula
items.what: Bob's reworked its cup-for-cup gluten-free flour to fix grittiness and aftertaste complaints. It's also the first product in the brand's redesigned packaging.

items.name: Island Towns tropical West Coast IPA
items.what: A new year-round 6.5% tropical West Coast IPA hopped with Superdelic, Citra and Chinook, announced in August 2026 in 6-packs of 12oz cans and on draft. It reuses the name of a 2025 one-off but is a new recipe.
